hardRules: Choose only templateId values from template-catalog.json templates[] or localAdapters[].
Prefer templateIds supported by src/templateRegistry.tsx for immediate rendering.
Use diagram only for concrete entities with links or dependencies.
Use code-panel only when repo, code, command, file tree, or execution is central.
Use asset-gallery templates only with sources classified as embed_asset.
Never embed assets classified as style_reference or context_only.
Do not invent numeric metrics to satisfy chart templates.
Keep long narration in subtitle.text or subtitle.segments.
Keep on-screen labels short enough for 1080x1920 mobile safe areas.
Record a reason for every scene template choice.

layoutRules.archetypeLibrary: Layout archetype definitions live in design/layout-library/index.json.
rules: No two consecutive scenes may use the same effective layout (a missing layout field counts as top-title).
A video with 5 or more scenes must use at least 3 distinct layouts.
Scenes with intent hook or takeaway should not use top-title; prefer center-stage, oversized-type, or bottom-statement.

subtitlePolicy.fallback: Split long narration into subtitle.segments and keep cards short.

qaChecks: No diagram fallback for non-relationship scenes.
No scene has more visual objects than its density budget.
No top-heavy layout: main content should stay between y=260 and y=1450.
Subtitle bar should not overlap main cards.
Each scene reason matches the narration intent.
